name: unity_scene_ops
description: Unity Editor scene operations via run_unity_python MCP tool. Use when AI needs to: (1) get scene info or hierarchy, (2) open/save/create scenes, (3) find GameObjects by name, tag, or layer, (4) manage Build Settings scene list, (5) query scene statistics (object count, dirty state, path). NOT for: runtime scene loading (Application.LoadScene), asset creation, component editing.
author: ArtClaw
